newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates thinly traded in nearbys.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates thinly traded in nearbys.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were thinly quoted Tuesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Monday.
- Three barges, St Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi River, bid 155 percent of tariff, no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid 105 percent, no comparison, offer 115 percent, no comparison.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi, next week, bid 130 percent, no comparison, offer 140 percent, no comparison.
- One barge, Cincinnati, Ohio River, on station, no bid, offer 100 percent, no comparison.
